name: media_bento_grid
title: Media Bento Grid
description: Brand & media section: a project's web media images (default web/media-website/*: banners, logo, wallpapers) in the same masonry as the photo gallery (renders media_gallery_filterable, no filters / paging by default): every image at its own shape, logos first on the canvas color, each opens in the popup gallery. A <section> of its own with a section_head.
